recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-12966; future blood-products-specific modeling should be handled in the separate blood product or administration issue family rather than this old ProcedureRequest tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-12966 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking to add dosageInstruction or quantity to ProcedureRequest and possibly DiagnosticRequest for blood-products-style orders; the final resolution deferred blood-product modeling and directed ServiceRequest inline supporting/order-detail and patient-instruction/provider-instruction capability covering FHIR-12966 and FHIR-14002.
initial_application: Historical commit 5971b343bd, 'Preapply [#12966], [#14002]', added ServiceRequest.orderDetail, ServiceRequest.patientInstruction, supportingInfo guidance, a servicerequest-orderdetail value set, and [#14002][#12966] committee notes. Current fhir.ini shows ServiceRequest active while ProcedureRequest is merged into ServiceRequest and DiagnosticOrder/DiagnosticRequest functionality is subsumed by later resources.
additional_context: Later final/applied decisions explain the current shape: FHIR-31589 clarified supportingInfo versus orderDetail, FHIR-32265 reshaped orderDetail into the parameter/value BackboneElement with Quantity and coded/string values, and FHIR-37355 changed supportingInfo to CodeableReference(Resource). The same-family issue FHIR-14002 is already represented on the combined branch by commit a91aeb7677, so it was not duplicated.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active ServiceRequest StructureDefinition already includes structured orderDetail, quantity[x], supportingInfo as CodeableReference(Resource), and patientInstruction, with comments steering delivery instructions to orderDetail rather than supportingInfo.

related_jiras.note: The FHIR-12966 resolution explicitly says the ServiceRequest orderDetail/patientInstruction structure also covers FHIR-14002; the related issue already has combined-branch audit commit a91aeb7677.
Clarified that supportingInfo is existing context while delivery instructions and questions belong in orderDetail.
Reshaped ServiceRequest.orderDetail into the current structured parameter/value BackboneElement with Quantity and coded values.
Changed ServiceRequest.supportingInfo to CodeableReference(Resource), explaining current coded supporting-info support.
